tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Building Your Portfolio Component 1

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring building your portfolio component 1. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to building your portfolio component 1, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with building your portfolio component 1. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with building your portfolio component 1. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Building Your Portfolio Component 1

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Review your current portfolio. Create an annotated plan showing how each section addresses the four AOs. Identify any gaps and suggest what you could add to improve AO coverage. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: map all four AOs clearly across the portfolio; show sustained, in-depth development; include strong written annotation with specialist vocabulary; demonstrate breadth through supporting studies; present work coherently with clear narrative; identify specific improvements with actionable plans. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
